title: Cover the registration confirmation response size boundary
outcome: Behavioral coverage distinguishes a complete registration confirmation exactly at 64 KiB from an oversized confirmation refused with HTTP 413, without truncation or timing/IO fixtures.
acceptance: A direct behavioral test constructs registration confirmation metadata whose encoded JSON is exactly 65,536 bytes and observes acceptance, then exceeds the bound and observes ApiError StatusCode::PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE; it verifies complete identity data is retained on acceptance and does not pin Markdown or instruction text.
